title: Crane curve construction
slide_intent: Expose underlying curve relationships because visual balance requires deliberate shaping.
strategic_value: The curve study can help preserve a coherent crane as its outline becomes lighter.
demonstration: A black crane and ring are overlaid with pale cyan circular construction guides.
practical_value: Compare the silhouette with its guiding curves before judging the isolated mark.

content_islands.name: Construction overlay
content_islands.spec: Retain the pale circular guides crossing the wing, neck and tail.
